target_policy: Development labels only; no holdout scoring. Full train labels used only for final fit.
context_policy: Transductive unlabeled full train+test roster: group size, peer attributes, unanimous imputation. No target propagation.
gate: Screen accuracy >0.83 and improvement >=0.001; both new split seeds improve; confirmation mean accuracy >0.83 and mean gain >=0.001. Candidate frozen before confirmation. User approval required before online submission.
planet_marginal_policy: HomePlanet posterior uses only outertrain rows with known HomePlanet, raw compact12 attributes excluding HomePlanet, Transported, IDs and missing-count proxies. Missing target-training rows expand into all three HomePlanet branches with posterior weights summing to one per original row. Observed rows have weight one. Original missingness information remains unchanged in both target training and prediction. Target CatBoost uses original v6 parameters. This is weighted complete-data logloss, not exact Bayesian observed-data marginal likelihood. Reuse the original v34 spatial spline trained only on original known Earth/sleep eligible outertrain rows; apply it to Earth prediction branches at original .5 weight. Only originally missing HomePlanet predictions change; observed HomePlanet rows return original v34 predictions bitwise unchanged.
